aiSettings.providerNoneHint: killBottleneck runs without AI — maps, tasks and sharing all work fully.
aiSettings.providerOllamaHint: A local model on your hardware — AI for free, quality depends on your model.
aiSettings.providerOpenaiHint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, vLLM, LM Studio… — enter an address, a key and a model name.
aiSettings.providerApiHint: A remote AI service compatible with the killBottleneck API — enter an address and a token.
aiSettings.providerCustomHint: Your own service with the same API contract (for advanced users).
aiSettings.heading: AI features
aiSettings.description: Where killBottleneck gets its AI (map suggestions, chat, tasks from a node, voice transcription). Changes apply immediately for all members.
aiSettings.envNotice: The .env configuration on the server is currently active — saving will override it.
aiSettings.transcribeLabel: Voice transcription endpoint (optional — without it dictation is off)
aiSettings.transcribeLabelOpenai: Voice transcription endpoint (optional — without it dictation goes to the chosen service)
aiSettings.transcribeModelLabel: Speech transcription model (optional — whisper-1 by default; Groq uses whisper-large-v3)
aiSettings.openaiHelp: Both the address and the exact model name come from your provider. Typically https://api.openai.com/v1, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, or the address of your own vLLM or LM Studio. On OpenAI the measured best choice is gpt-4o-mini; avoid reasoning models (gpt-5-*, o4-*) — they are slower, pricier, and some features fail on them outright. The key only ever goes to that address and is never handed back to the browser. Your provider bills you for the requests, not us.
aiSettings.ollamaHelp: Ollama on this machine: killBottleneck runs in Docker, so localhost won't work — use http://172.17.0.1:11434 (Linux) or http://host.docker.internal:11434 (Docker Desktop). Ollama on another machine on the network: http://IP-address:11434 and enable network access on it (OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0).

apiKeys.copyManual: Couldn't copy — select and copy it manually
apiKeys.rotateTitle: Rotate key (new token, the old one stops working)
apiKeys.mcpCommandHint: Replace kb_user_… with your key. Claude Desktop and other clients: see the MCP docs.
apiKeys.mcpCommandHintFresh: The command already contains the new key — copy it now, the key won't be shown again.
